title: The Supertrace Defect of a Graded Endomorphism
summary: Motivated by Igusa's relation between relative cyclic homology and the logarithm of the graded Cartan determinant, we isolate the homological step behind the passage from logarithmic determinants to traces of powers. For a bounded chain complex $(C_*,d)$ and a degree-zero graded endomorphism $f$, not assumed to commute with $d$, we construct the universal quotient on which $f$ becomes a chain map.
